E                   return;

E                   const res = await api('POST', '/torrents/add-file', form, 60000);

E                   toast(sanitizeErrorMsg(e.message), 'error');
E                 } finally {
E                   input.value = '';

E               function resizeDebridLinkInput(input) {
E                 if (!input) return;
E                 const styles = window.getComputedStyle(input);
E                 const lineHeight = parseFloat(styles.lineHeight) || 18;
E                 const chrome = (parseFloat(styles.paddingTop) || 0) +
E                   (parseFloat(styles.paddingBottom) || 0) +
E                   (parseFloat(styles.borderTopWidth) || 0) +
E                   (parseFloat(styles.borderBottomWidth) || 0);
E                 const minimum = Math.ceil((lineHeight * 2) + chrome);
E                 const maximum = Math.ceil((lineHeight * 5) + chrome);
E                 input.style.height = `${minimum}px`;
E                 const target = Math.max(minimum, Math.min(input.scrollHeight, maximum));
E                 input.style.height = `${target}px`;
E                 input.style.overflowY = input.scrollHeight > maximum ? 'auto' : 'hidden';
E               }

E               function classifyDashboardEntries(raw) {
E                 const seen = new Set();
E                 const direct = [];
E                 const magnets = [];
E                 const invalid = [];
E                 String(raw || '').split(/\r?\n/).forEach((rawValue, index) => {
E                   const value = rawValue.trim();
E                   if (!value || seen.has(value)) return;
E                   seen.add(value);
E                   const entry = {value, line: index + 1};
E                   if (/^https?:\/\/\S+$/i.test(value)) direct.push(entry);
E                   else if (/^magnet:\?/i.test(value)) magnets.push(entry);
E                   else invalid.push(entry);
E                 });
E                 return {direct, magnets, invalid};
E               }

E               async function mapWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, worker) {
E                 const results = new Array(items.length);
E                 let cursor = 0;
E                 async function run() {
E                   while (cursor < items.length) {
E                     const index = cursor++;
E                     try {
E                       results[index] = {ok: true, value: await worker(items[index])};
E                     } catch (error) {
E                       results[index] = {ok: false, error};
E                     }
E                   }
E                 }
E                 const workers = Array.from(
E                   {length: Math.min(Math.max(1, concurrency), Math.max(1, items.length))},
E                   () => run()
E                 );
E                 await Promise.all(workers);
E                 return results;
E               }

E               function downloadPaginationSummary(total, from, to) {
E                 const search = document.getElementById('torrent-search');
E                 if (search && search.value.trim()) {
E                   if (total <= 0) return 'No downloads match your search';
E                   if (total === 1 && from === 1 && to === 1) return 'Showing 1 matching download';

E                 }
E                 const status = activeDownloadFilterStatus();
E                 const language = {
E                   '': ['No Items Added Yet', 'Showing 1 Added Item', n => 'Showing ' + n + ' Added Items'],
E                   downloading: ['No Active Downloads', '1 Active Download', n => n + ' Active Downloads'],
E                   paused: ['No Paused Downloads', '1 Paused Download', n => n + ' Paused Downloads'],
E                   processing: ['No Downloads Currently Processing', '1 Download Currently Processing', n => n + ' Downloads Currently Processing'],
E                   ready: ['No Downloads in Ready State', '1 Download in Ready State', n => n + ' Downloads in Ready State'],
E                   completed: ['No Downloads Completed Yet', '1 Download Completed', n => n + ' Downloads Completed'],
E                   error: ['No Downloads Have Errors', '1 Download Has Errors', n => n + ' Downloads Have Errors'],
E                 }[status];
E                 if (!language) return total === 1 ? '1 Download' : total + ' Downloads';
E                 return total <= 0 ? language[0] : total === 1 ? language[1] : language[2](total);
E               }

E               async function addMagnet() {
E                 const input = document.getElementById('t-magnet');
E                 const v = input.value.trim();
E                 if (!v) {
E                   openTorrentFilePicker();
E                   return;
E                 }
E                 try {
E                   const res = await api('POST','/torrents/add-magnet',{magnet:v}, 30000);
E                   if (res && res._duplicate && res._duplicate.action === 'skip') {
E                     toast('Already in queue: ' + (res.name || res._duplicate.reason), 'warn');

E                   }
E                   input.value = '';
E                   input.focus();
E                   loadTorrents();

E               async function deleteT(id, eventObj, button) {
E                 eventObj?.stopPropagation();
E               
E                 if (!confirm('Delete from AllDebrid and remove from list?')) {
E                   return;
E                 }
E               
E                 setButtonPending(button, true, 'Deleting…');
E               
E                 try {
E                   await api(
E                     'DELETE',
E                     `/torrents/${id}?from_alldebrid=true`
E                   );
E               
E                   toast('Deleted','success');
E                   loadTorrents();
E                   loadStats();
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   toast(sanitizeErrorMsg(e.message),'error');
E                 } finally {
E                   setButtonPending(button, false);
E                 }
E               }

E                       <div><div class="dk">Added</div><div class="dv">${fmtDate(t.created_at)}</div></div>
E                       <div><div class="dk">Completed</div><div class="dv">${fmtDate(t.completed_at)}</div></div>
E                       <div class="dp-detail-original-resource" style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="dk">Original Resource</div><div class="dv">${esc(t.original_resource || '—')}</div></div>
E                       <div style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="dk">Transfer ID</div><div class="dv">${t.id}</div></div>
E                       <div style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="dk">Hash</div><div class="dv" style="font-size:11px">${esc(t.hash||'—')}</div></div>
E                       ${t.local_path?`<div style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="dk">Local Path</div><div class="dv" style="font-size:11px">${esc(t.local_path)}</div></div>`:''}
E                       ${t.error_message?`<div style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="dk">Error</div><div class="dv" style="color:var(--red)">${esc(t.error_message)}</div></div>`:''}
E                       ${t.extraction_status?`<div><div class="dk">Extraction</div><div class="dv">${esc(t.extraction_status)}</div></div>`:''}
E                       ${t.extraction_error?`<div style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="dk">Extraction Error</div><div class="dv" style="color:var(--red)">${esc(t.extraction_error)}</div></div>`:''}
E                     </div>
E                     <div class="card dp-detail-section-card dp-detail-route-history">
E                       <div class="card-header"><span class="card-title">Route History</span></div>
E                       <div class="dp-detail-route-body">${renderRouteHistory(t)}</div>
E                     </div>
E                     <details class="dp-detail-advanced">
E                       <summary>Advanced acquisition details</summary>
E                       <div class="dp-detail-advanced-grid">
E                         <div><span>Executor</span><strong>${esc((t.executors || []).join(', ') || '—')}</strong></div>
E                         <div><span>Current Provider ID</span><strong>${esc(t.current_provider_id || '—')}</strong></div>
E                         <div><span>Delivering Provider ID</span><strong>${esc(t.delivering_provider_id || '—')}</strong></div>
E                       </div>
E                     </details>
E                     ${t.files&&t.files.length?`
E                       <div class="card dp-detail-section-card dp-detail-files-card">
E                         <div class="card-header">
E                           <span class="card-title">Files (${t.files.length})</span>
E                         </div>
E                         <div class="dp-detail-table-wrap">
E                           <table class="t-table">
E                             <thead><tr><th>Filename</th><th>Size</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
E                             <tbody>${t.files.map(f=>`<tr>
E                               <td class="dp-detail-filename">${esc(f.filename)}
E                                 ${f.blocked
E                                   ? `<span class="badge badge-error" style="font-size:9px;margin-left:6px">BLOCKED: ${esc(f.block_reason)}</span>`
E                                   : (f.block_reason ? `<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--red);margin-top:4px">${esc(f.block_reason)}</div>` : '')}
E                               </td>
E                               <td class="sz">${fmtSize(f.size_bytes)}</td>
E                               <td>${badge(f.status, f)}</td>
E                             </tr>`).join('')}</tbody>
E                           </table>
E                         </div>
E                       </div>
E                     `:''}
E                     ${t.source_outcomes && t.source_outcomes.length ? `
E                       <div class="card dp-detail-section-card">
E                         <div class="card-header"><span class="card-title">Source Warnings (${t.source_outcomes.length})</span></div>
E                         <div class="dp-detail-table-wrap"><table class="t-table"><tbody>
E                           ${t.source_outcomes.map(source => `<tr><td>${esc(source.name)}</td><td>${badge('error', source)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
E                         </tbody></table></div>
E                       </div>
E                     ` : ''}
E                     ${t.events&&t.events.length?`
E                       <div class="card dp-detail-section-card dp-detail-events-card">
E                         <div class="card-header">
E                           <span class="card-title">Events</span>
E                         </div>
E                         <div class="dp-detail-events-list">
E                           ${t.events.map(ev=>`
E                             <div class="event-item">
E                               <div class="elevel ${esc(ev.level)}"></div>
E                               <div class="emsg">${esc(ev.message)}</div>
E                               <div class="etime">${fmtDate(ev.created_at)}</div>
E                             </div>`).join('')}
E                         </div>
E                       </div>
E                     `:''}
E                   `;
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   if (modalBody) {
E                     modalBody.innerHTML =
E                       `<div class="empty" style="padding:24px">Failed to load details: ${esc(sanitizeErrorMsg(e.message))}</div>`;
E                   }
E               
E                   toast(sanitizeErrorMsg(e.message),'error');
E                 }
E               }

E               function closeModal(e) {
E                 if (!e || e.target === document.getElementById('overlay'))
E                   document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('open');
E               }

E               // ── Theme toggle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
E               function toggleSidebar() {
E                 document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('open');
E                 document.getElementById('mobile-overlay').classList.toggle('open');
E               }
E               function closeSidebar() {
E                 document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('open');
E                 document.getElementById('mobile-overlay').classList.remove('open');

E               function toggleTheme() {
E                 const isLight = document.body.classList.toggle('light');
E                 localStorage.setItem('theme', isLight ? 'light' : 'dark');
E                 updateThemeToggle(isLight);
E                 document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('debridpulse:theme-changed', {detail:{light:isLight}}));
E               }
E               
E               function updateThemeToggle(isLight) {
E                 const btn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
E                 if (!btn) return;
E                 if (!window.DPIcons || typeof window.DPIcons.renderThemeGlyph !== 'function') {
E                   throw new Error('DebridPulse icon runtime is unavailable');
E                 }
E                 const action = isLight ? 'Switch to dark mode' : 'Switch to light mode';
E                 btn.title = action;
E                 btn.setAttribute('aria-label', action);
E                 window.DPIcons.renderThemeGlyph(!!isLight);
E               }
E               document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
E                 setInterval(function() {
E                   if (settingsData && (settingsData.aria2_mode||'builtin')==='builtin') {
E                     loadAria2Runtime().catch(()=>{});
E                   }
E                 }, 5000);
E                 setInterval(function() {
E                   loadAria2TopbarStat().catch(()=>{});
E                 }, 1000);
E                 document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
E                   if (!event.target.closest('.aria2-cap-control')) closeAria2SpeedCapMenu();
E                 });
E                 document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
E                   if (event.key === 'Escape') closeAria2SpeedCapMenu();
E                 });
E                 window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
E                   clearTimeout(_dashboardRecentResizeTimer);
E                   _dashboardRecentResizeTimer = setTimeout(function() {
E                     if (!document.getElementById('view-dashboard')?.classList.contains('active')) return;
E                     const fittedLimit = dashboardRecentLimit();
E                     if (fittedLimit !== _dashboardRecentFitLimit) {
E                       _dashboardRecentFitLimit = fittedLimit;
E                       loadRecent().catch(() => {});
E                     }
E                   }, 120);
E                 });
E                 const isLight = localStorage.getItem('theme') === 'light';
E                 document.body.classList.toggle('light', isLight);
E                 updateThemeToggle(isLight);
E                 document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('debridpulse:theme-changed', {detail:{light:isLight}}));
E               });

E               // ── Bulk selection ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
E               let _selectedIds = new Set();
E               
E               function onCheckboxChange() {
E                 _selectedIds = new Set(
E                   [...document.querySelectorAll('.t-chk:checked')].map(el => parseInt(el.dataset.id))
E                 );
E                 const bar = document.getElementById('bulk-bar');
E                 const cnt = document.getElementById('bulk-count');
E                 if (_selectedIds.size > 0) {
E                   bar.classList.add('visible');
E                   cnt.textContent = _selectedIds.size + ' Selected';
E                 } else {
E                   bar.classList.remove('visible');
E                 }
E                 const all = document.getElementById('chk-all');
E                 const total = document.querySelectorAll('.t-chk').length;
E                 if (all) all.indeterminate = _selectedIds.size > 0 && _selectedIds.size < total;
E               }
E               
E               function toggleAllCheckboxes(el) {
E                 document.querySelectorAll('.t-chk').forEach(c => {
E                   c.checked = el.checked;
E                 });
E                 onCheckboxChange();
E               }
E               
E               function clearSelection() {
E                 _selectedIds.clear();
E                 document.querySelectorAll('.t-chk').forEach(c => c.checked = false);
E                 const all = document.getElementById('chk-all');
E                 if (all) { all.checked = false; all.indeterminate = false; }
E                 document.getElementById('bulk-bar').classList.remove('visible');
E               }
E               
E               async function bulkAction(action, button) {
E                 if (!_selectedIds.size) return;
E               
E                 const ids = [..._selectedIds];
E               
E                 if (
E                   action === 'delete' &&
E                   !confirm(`Delete ${ids.length} torrents?`)
E                 ) {
E                   return;
E                 }
E               
E                 const pendingLabels = {
E                   delete: 'Deleting…',
E                   reset: 'Resetting…',
E                   pause: 'Pausing…',
E                   resume: 'Resuming…',
E                 };
E               
E                 setButtonPending(
E                   button,
E                   true,
E                   pendingLabels[action] || 'Working…'
E                 );
E               
E                 try {
E                   const r =
E                     await api(
E                       'POST',
E                       '/torrents/bulk',
E                       {ids, action}
E                     );
E               
E                   toast(
E                     `Done: ${r.ok} ok, ${r.failed} failed`,
E                     r.failed ? 'warn' : 'success'
E                   );
E               
E                   clearSelection();
E                   loadTorrents();
E                   loadStats();
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   toast(e.message, 'error');
E                 } finally {
E                   setButtonPending(button, false);
E                   document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('debridpulse:downloads-bulk-action-settled', {detail:{action}}));
E                 }
E               }
E               
E               async function setLabel(id) {
E                 const label = prompt('Label (leave empty to clear):') ?? null;
E                 if (label === null) return;
E                 try {
E                   await api('PUT', `/torrents/${id}/label`, {label: label.trim(), priority: 0});
E                   toast('Label updated', 'success');
E                   loadTorrents();
E                 } catch(e) { toast(e.message, 'error'); }
E               }
E               
E               // ── Events ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
E               let _allEvents = [];
E               
E               async function loadEvents() {
E                 try {
E                   _allEvents = await api('GET','/events?limit=500');
E                   filterEvents();
E                 } catch(e) { toast(sanitizeErrorMsg(e.message),'error'); }
E               }
E               
E               function filterEvents() {
E                 const el = document.getElementById('event-list');
E                 const q   = (document.getElementById('ev-search')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
E                 const lvl = document.getElementById('ev-level')?.value || '';
E                 const evs = _allEvents.filter(ev => {
E                   if (lvl && ev.level !== lvl) return false;
E                   if (!q) return true;
E                   return (ev.message||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
E                          (ev.torrent_name||'').toLowerCase().includes(q);
E                 });
E                 if (!evs.length) {
E                   el.innerHTML='<div class="empty">No events match the filter.</div>';
E                   document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('debridpulse:activity-rendered'));
E                   return;
E                 }
E                 el.innerHTML = evs.map(ev=>`
E                   <div class="dp-activity-row">
E                     <div class="elevel dp-activity-level ${esc(ev.level)}"></div>
E                     <div class="dp-activity-copy"><div class="emsg dp-activity-message">${esc(ev.message)}</div>${ev.torrent_name?`<div class="ename dp-activity-transfer">${esc(ev.torrent_name)}</div>`:''}</div>
E                     <div class="etime dp-activity-time">${fmtDate(ev.created_at)}</div>
E                   </div>`).join('');
E                 document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('debridpulse:activity-rendered'));
E               }

E               function toggleFilterFields() {
E                 const enabled = document.getElementById('s-filters_enabled')?.checked;
E                 const fields = document.getElementById('filter-fields');
E                 if (fields) {
E                   fields.style.opacity = enabled ? '' : '0.4';
E                   fields.style.pointerEvents = enabled ? '' : 'none';
E                 }
E               }

E               async function triggerFullSync(button) {
E                 setButtonPending(
E                   button,
E                   true,
E                   'Syncing…'
E                 );
E               
E                 try {
E                   const r =
E                     await api(
E                       'POST',
E                       '/admin/full-sync'
E                     );
E               
E                   toast(
E                     'Full sync: ' +
E                       r.updated +
E                       ' torrent(s) updated',
E                     r.updated > 0
E                       ? 'success'
E                       : 'info'
E                   );
E               
E                   setTimeout(() => {
E                     loadStats();
E                     loadRecent();
E                   }, 1500);
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   toast(
E                     e.message,
E                     'error'
E                   );
E                 } finally {
E                   setButtonPending(button, false);
E                 }
E               }

E               async function saveSettings(button) {
E                 setButtonPending(button, true, 'Saving…');
E               
E                 try {
E                   const activeTab =
E                     getActiveSettingsTab();
E               
E                   const d =
E                     getFormSettings();
E               
E                   settingsData =
E                     await api('PUT','/settings',d);
E               
E                   renderSettings();
E                   switchSettingsTab(activeTab);
E                   updateAria2ngLink();
E               
E                   toast(
E                     'Settings saved!',
E                     'success'
E                   );
E               
E                   checkConnections();
E                   loadAria2SpeedLimit();
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   toast(
E                     sanitizeErrorMsg(e.message),
E                     'error'
E                   );
E                 } finally {
E                   setButtonPending(button, false);
E                 }
E               }

E                   button,

E                     'error'
E                   );

E               
E               function _updatePremiumLabel(r) {
E                 const row = document.getElementById('premium-row');
E                 const lbl = document.getElementById('lbl-premium');
E                 if (!row || !lbl) return;
E                 if (!r || !r.isPremium) { row.style.display = 'none'; return; }
E                 // AllDebrid user object has premiumUntil as unix timestamp
E                 const until = r.premiumUntil || r.premium_until || 0;
E                 if (!until) { row.style.display = 'none'; return; }
E                 const d = new Date(until * 1000);
E                 const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
E                 const mm = String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
E                 const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
E                 const days = Math.ceil((d - Date.now()) / 86400000);
E                 const daysLabel = days > 0 ? `${days} days` : 'expired';
E                 lbl.innerHTML = `Premium until ${dd}.${mm}.${yyyy} (${daysLabel})`;
E                 row.style.display = '';
E               }

E               
E               function renderAria2Diagnostics(diag) {
E                 const el = document.getElementById('aria2-memory-diagnostics');
E                 if (!el) return;
E                 if (!diag) {
E                   el.textContent = '';
E                   return;
E                 }
E                 const opts = diag.global_options || {};
E                 const limits = diag.query_limits || {};
E                 el.innerHTML =
E                   `<b>aria2 memory diagnostics</b><br>` +
E                   `Active: ${diag.active_count ?? 0} · Waiting: ${diag.waiting_count ?? 0} · Stopped: ${diag.stopped_count ?? 0}<br>` +
E                   `max-download-result: ${esc(opts['max-download-result'] || 'n/a')} · keep-unfinished-download-result: ${esc(opts['keep-unfinished-download-result'] || 'n/a')}<br>` +
E                   `query window — waiting: ${limits.waiting ?? 'n/a'} · stopped: ${limits.stopped ?? 'n/a'}`;
E               }
E               
E               function renderAria2Runtime(data) {
E                 const el = document.getElementById('aria2-runtime-status');
E                 if (!el) return;
E                 if (!data) {
E                   el.textContent = 'Runtime status not loaded yet.';
E                   return;
E                 }
E                 const mode = data.mode || 'external';
E                 const state = data.running ? 'Running' : (mode === 'builtin' ? 'Stopped' : 'External');
E                 const rpc = data.rpc_ok ? 'RPC online' : (mode === 'builtin' ? 'RPC offline' : 'External RPC');
E                 const version = data.version ? ` · v${data.version}` : '';
E                 const uptime = data.uptime_seconds ? ` · uptime ${Math.floor(data.uptime_seconds / 60)}m` : '';
E                 const secret = data.secret_managed ? ' · internal secret managed' : '';
E                 const dir = data.download_dir ? `<br>Download folder: ${esc(data.download_dir)}` : '';
E                 const diag = data.diagnostics || {};
E                 const counts = diag && !diag.error
E                   ? `<br>Active: ${diag.active_count ?? 0} · Waiting: ${diag.waiting_count ?? 0} · Stopped: ${diag.stopped_count ?? 0}`
E                   : '';
E                 const err = data.last_error ? `<br><span style="color:var(--red)">${esc(data.last_error)}</span>` : '';
E                 el.innerHTML = `<b>${esc(state)}</b> · ${esc(mode)} · ${esc(rpc)}${esc(version)}${esc(uptime)}${secret}<br>${esc(data.rpc_url || '')}${counts}${err}`;
E                 el.innerHTML += dir;
E                 if (data.last_output) el.innerHTML += `<br><small>${esc(data.last_output)}</small>`;
E                 renderAria2Diagnostics(diag && !diag.error ? diag : null);
E               }
E               
E               function aria2StatusLabel(status) {
E                 const map = {active:'Downloading', waiting:'Waiting', paused:'Paused', complete:'Complete', error:'Error', removed:'Removed'};
E                 const cls = status === 'active' ? 'downloading' : status === 'complete' ? 'completed' : status === 'error' ? 'error' : status === 'paused' ? 'paused' : 'queued';
E                 return `<span class="badge badge-${cls}">${esc(map[status] || status || 'Unknown')}</span>`;
E               }
E               
E               function renderAria2Downloads(data) {
E                 const el = document.getElementById('aria2-downloads');
E                 if (!el) return;
E                 if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.items)) {
E                   el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Queue not loaded yet.</div>';
E                   return;
E                 }
E                 const summary = data.summary || {};
E                 const items = data.items || [];
E                 const ordered = items.slice().sort((a,b) => {
E                   const weight = {active:0, waiting:1, paused:2, error:3, complete:4};
E                   return (weight[a.status] ?? 9) - (weight[b.status] ?? 9);
E                 });
E                 const header = `
E                   <div class="aria2-summary">
E                     <span class="aria2-chip">Active: ${summary.active ?? 0}</span>
E                     <span class="aria2-chip">Waiting: ${summary.waiting ?? 0}</span>
E                     <span class="aria2-chip">Stopped: ${summary.stopped ?? 0}</span>
E                     <span class="aria2-chip">Speed: ${fmtSpeed(summary.download_speed || 0)}</span>
E                     <span class="aria2-chip">Remaining: ${fmtSize(summary.remaining_length || 0)}</span>
E                   </div>`;
E                 if (!ordered.length) {
E                   el.innerHTML = header + '<div class="empty">No aria2 jobs currently visible.</div>';
E                   return;
E                 }
E                 el.innerHTML = header + ordered.map(job => {
E                   const canPause = job.status === 'active' || job.status === 'waiting';
E                   const canResume = job.status === 'paused';
E                   const files = (job.files || []).slice(0, 4).map(file => `
E                     <div title="${esc(file.path || '')}">
E                       ${esc(file.name || file.path || 'file')} · ${Math.max(0, file.progress || 0).toFixed(1)}% · ${fmtSize(file.completed_length || 0)} / ${fmtSize(file.length || 0)}
E                     </div>`).join('');
E                   const more = (job.files || []).length > 4 ? `<div>+ ${(job.files || []).length - 4} more file(s)</div>` : '';
E                   const error = job.error_message ? `<div class="aria2-error">${esc((job.error || {}).category || '')} ${esc(job.error_message)}</div>` : '';
E                   return `
E                     <div class="aria2-job">
E                       <div class="aria2-job-top">
E                         <div class="aria2-job-title">
E                           <div class="aria2-job-name" title="${esc(job.name || '')}">${esc(job.name || job.gid || 'aria2 job')}</div>
E                           <div class="aria2-job-meta" title="${esc(job.path || '')}">${esc(job.gid || '')}${job.path ? ' · ' + esc(job.path) : ''}</div>
E                         </div>
E                         <div class="aria2-actions">
E                           ${canPause ? `<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="aria2DownloadAction('${esc(job.gid)}','pause',this)">Pause</button>` : ''}
E                           ${canResume ? `<button class="btn btn-blue btn-sm" onclick="aria2DownloadAction('${esc(job.gid)}','resume',this)">Resume</button>` : ''}
E                           <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="aria2DownloadAction('${esc(job.gid)}','remove',this)">Remove</button>
E                         </div>
E                       </div>
E                       <div>${progress(job.progress || 0, job.status === 'complete' ? 'completed' : 'downloading')}</div>
E                       <div class="aria2-job-grid">
E                         <div><div class="aria2-k">Status</div><div class="aria2-v">${aria2StatusLabel(job.status)}</div></div>
E                         <div><div class="aria2-k">Speed</div><div class="aria2-v">${fmtSpeed(job.download_speed || 0)}</div></div>
E                         <div><div class="aria2-k">Done</div><div class="aria2-v">${fmtSize(job.completed_length || 0)} / ${fmtSize(job.total_length || 0)}</div></div>
E                         <div><div class="aria2-k">Remaining</div><div class="aria2-v">${fmtSize(job.remaining_length || 0)}</div></div>
E                       </div>
E                       ${error}
E                       ${(files || more) ? `<div class="aria2-file-list">${files}${more}</div>` : ''}
E                     </div>`;
E                 }).join('');
E               }
E               
E               async function loadAria2Downloads() {
E                 try {
E                   const data =
E                     await api(
E                       'GET',
E                       '/aria2/downloads'
E                     );
E               
E                   renderAria2Downloads(data);
E               
E                   return data;
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   const el =
E                     document.getElementById(
E                       'aria2-downloads'
E                     );
E               
E                   if (el) {
E                     el.innerHTML =
E                       `<div class="aria2-error">Queue error: ${esc(e.message)}</div>`;
E                   }
E               
E                   throw e;
E                 }
E               }
E               
E               loadAria2Downloads =
E                 coalesceAsync(loadAria2Downloads);
E               
E               async function refreshAria2Downloads(button) {
E                 setButtonPending(
E                   button,
E                   true,
E                   'Refreshing…'
E                 );
E               
E                 try {
E                   await loadAria2Downloads();
E                 } catch (_) {
E                   // loadAria2Downloads owns its visible error state.
E                 } finally {
E                   setButtonPending(button, false);
E                 }
E               }
E               
E               async function aria2DownloadAction(gid, action, button) {
E                 const pendingLabels = {
E                   pause: 'Pausing…',
E                   resume: 'Resuming…',
E                   remove: 'Removing…',
E                 };
E               
E                 setButtonPending(
E                   button,
E                   true,
E                   pendingLabels[action] || 'Working…'
E                 );
E               
E                 try {
E                   await api(
E                     'POST',
E                     `/aria2/downloads/${encodeURIComponent(gid)}/${action}`
E                   );
E               
E                   toast(
E                     `aria2 ${action} sent`,
E                     'success'
E                   );
E               
E                   await loadAria2Downloads();
E                   await loadAria2Runtime();
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   toast(
E                     `aria2 ${action}: ${e.message}`,
E                     'error'
E                   );
E                 } finally {
E                   setButtonPending(button, false);
E                   document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('debridpulse:aria2-engine-action-settled', {detail:{gid, action}}));
E                 }
E               }
E               
E               async function loadAria2Runtime() {
E                 try {
E                   const data = await api('GET', '/aria2/runtime');
E                   renderAria2Runtime(data);
E                   const badge = document.getElementById('aria2-speed-badge');
E                   if (badge) {
E                     const isBuiltin = (data.mode || '') === 'builtin';
E               
E                     if (settingsData) {
E                       _aria2BadgeState.limitBps =
E                         parseInt(settingsData.aria2_max_download_limit) || 0;
E                       _aria2BadgeState.maxDl =
E                         parseInt(
E                           settingsData.max_concurrent_downloads ??
E                           settingsData.aria2_max_active_downloads
E                         ) || 3;
E                     }
E               
E                     if (isBuiltin && !data.running) {
E                       badge.style.display = 'none';
E                     } else if (isBuiltin) {
E                       badge.style.display = 'flex';
E                       updateAria2TopbarBadge({
E                         active: Number(data.active) || 0,
E                         liveBps: Number(data.download_speed) || 0,
E                         externalControl: false,
E                       });
E                       loadAria2SpeedLimit().catch(function(){});
E                     } else {
E                       badge.style.display = 'flex';
E                       updateAria2TopbarBadge({
E                         maxDl: _aria2BadgeState.maxDl,
E                         externalControl: true,
E                       });
E                       loadAria2TopbarStat().catch(function(){});
E                     }
E                   }
E                   return data;
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   const el = document.getElementById('aria2-runtime-status');
E                   if (el) el.innerHTML = `<span style="color:var(--red)">Runtime error: ${esc(e.message)}</span>`;
E                   throw e;
E                 }
E               }
E               
E               async function aria2RuntimeAction(action, button) {
E                 const pendingLabels = {
E                   start: 'Starting…',
E                   restart: 'Restarting…',
E                   stop: 'Stopping…',
E                   apply: 'Applying…',
E                 };
E               
E                 setButtonPending(
E                   button,
E                   true,
E                   pendingLabels[action] || 'Working…'
E                 );
E               
E                 try {
E                   const current =
E                     getFormSettings();
E               
E                   settingsData =
E                     await api(
E                       'PUT',
E                       '/settings',
E                       current
E                     );
E               
E                   const data =
E                     await api(
E                       'POST',
E                       `/aria2/runtime/${action}`
E                     );
E               
E                   renderAria2Runtime(data);
E                   loadAria2Downloads().catch(()=>{});
E               
E                   toast(
E                     `aria2 ${action} complete`,
E                     'success'
E                   );
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   toast(
E                     `aria2 ${action}: ${e.message}`,
E                     'error'
E                   );
E               
E                   loadAria2Runtime().catch(()=>{});
E                 } finally {
E                   setButtonPending(button, false);
E                 }
E               }

E                 setButtonPending(
E                   button,
E                   true,
E                   'Cleaning…'

E                 try {

E                     getFormSettings();

E                   settingsData =

E                       current

E               
E                   const r =
E                     await api(

E                       '/settings/aria2-housekeeping'
E                     );

E                   renderAria2Diagnostics(
E                     r.diagnostics || null
E                   );
E               
E                   toast(
E                     'aria2 cleanup finished',
E                     'success'
E                   );
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   toast(
E                     e.message,
E                     'error'
E                   );
E                 } finally {
E                   setButtonPending(button, false);
E                 }
E               }

E               async function uploadDiscordAvatar(input) {
E                 const file = input.files[0];
E                 if (!file) return;
E                 const formData = new FormData();
E                 formData.append('file', file);
E                 try {
E                   const resp = await fetch('/api/settings/upload-avatar', {method:'POST', body: formData});
E                   const data = await resp.json();
E                   if (!resp.ok) { toast(data.detail || 'Upload failed', 'error'); return; }
E                   // Discord requires a real HTTP URL, not a data URI
E                   // The server saves the file and returns the public URL
E                   document.getElementById('s-discord_avatar_url').value = data.url;
E                   showAvatarPreview(data.url, file.name, data.size_bytes);
E                   toast('Avatar uploaded — URL: ' + data.url, 'success');
E                   if (data.warning) toast(data.warning, 'warn');
E                 } catch(e) { toast(e.message, 'error'); }
E                 input.value = '';
E               }
E               
E               function showAvatarPreview(src, name, bytes) {
E                 const preview = document.getElementById('avatar-preview');
E                 const img = document.getElementById('avatar-preview-img');
E                 const lbl = document.getElementById('avatar-preview-label');
E                 if (!preview) return;
E                 img.src = src;
E                 lbl.textContent = (name || 'Custom avatar') + (bytes > 0 ? ' (' + Math.round(bytes/1024) + ' KB)' : '');
E                 preview.style.display = 'flex';
E               }
E               
E               function clearDiscordAvatar() {
E                 document.getElementById('s-discord_avatar_url').value = '';
E                 const preview = document.getElementById('avatar-preview');
E                 if (preview) preview.style.display = 'none';
E               }

E               async function triggerBackup() {
E                 try {
E                   toast('Running backup…', 'info');
E                   const r = await api('POST', '/admin/backup');
E                   if (r.skipped) { toast('Backup disabled in settings', 'warn'); return; }
E                   toast(`Backup done: ${r.backed_up.join(', ')} (${r.rotated} old removed)`, 'success');
E                   loadBackupList();
E                 } catch(e) { toast(e.message, 'error'); }
E               }
E               
E               async function loadBackupList() {
E                 try {
E                   const r = await api('GET', '/admin/backups');
E                   const el = document.getElementById('backup-list');
E                   if (!el) return;
E                   if (!r.backups.length) { el.textContent = 'No backups found.'; return; }
E                   el.innerHTML = r.backups.map(b =>
E                     `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)">
E                       <span>${esc(b.name)}</span>
E                       <span style="color:var(--text3)">${esc((b.files||[]).join(', '))} — ${Math.round(Number(b.size_bytes||0)/1024)} KB</span>
E                     </div>`
E                   ).join('');
E                 } catch(e) { toast(e.message, 'error'); }
E               }
E               
E               async function triggerDatabaseBackup() {
E                 try {
E                   toast('Running database backup…', 'info');
E                   const r = await api('POST', '/admin/database/backup');
E                   if (r.skipped) { toast('Database backup disabled in settings', 'warn'); return; }
E                   toast(`Database backup done (${Object.values(r.tables || {}).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)} rows exported)`, 'success');
E                   loadDatabaseBackupList();
E                 } catch(e) { toast(e.message, 'error'); }
E               }

E               async function loadDatabaseBackupList() {

E                   const el = document.getElementById('db-backup-list');
E                   if (!el) return;
E                   if (!r.backups.length) { el.textContent = 'No database backups found.'; return; }
E                   el.innerHTML = r.backups.map(b =>
E                     `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)">
E                       <span>${esc(b.name)}</span>
E                       <span style="color:var(--text3)">${esc((b.files||[]).join(', '))} — ${Math.round(Number(b.size_bytes||0)/1024)} KB</span>
E                     </div>`
E                   ).join('');
E                 } catch(e) { toast(e.message, 'error'); }
E               }

E               async function wipeDatabase(button) {
E                 const enabled =
E                   document
E                     .getElementById(
E                       's-db_wipe_enabled'
E                     )
E                     ?.checked;
E               
E                 if (!enabled) {
E                   toast(
E                     'Enable database wipe in settings first',
E                     'warn'
E                   );
E                   return;
E                 }
E               
E                 if (
E                   !confirm(
E                     'This will remove all database rows. Continue?'
E                   )
E                 ) {
E                   return;
E                 }
E               
E                 const confirmText =
E                   prompt(
E                     'Type WIPE to confirm database wipe'
E                   );
E               
E                 if (confirmText !== 'WIPE') return;
E               
E                 // Start pending state only after explicit operator confirmation.
E                 setButtonPending(
E                   button,
E                   true,
E                   'Wiping…'
E                 );
E               
E                 try {
E                   toast(
E                     'Wiping database…',
E                     'warn'
E                   );
E               
E                   const r =
E                     await api(
E                       'POST',
E                       '/admin/database/wipe',
E                       {confirm: true}
E                     );
E               
E                   if (
E                     r.backup &&
E                     !r.backup.skipped
E                   ) {
E                     toast(
E                       'Database wiped. Pre-wipe backup created.',
E                       'success'
E                     );
E                   } else {
E                     toast(
E                       'Database wiped.',
E                       'success'
E                     );
E                   }
E               
E                   loadDatabaseBackupList();
E                   loadStats().catch(()=>{});
E                   loadRecent().catch(()=>{});
E               
E                   if (
E                     document
E                       .getElementById('view-torrents')
E                       ?.classList.contains('active')
E                   ) {
E                     loadTorrents().catch(()=>{});
E                   }
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   toast(
E                     e.message,
E                     'error'
E                   );
E                 } finally {
E                   setButtonPending(button, false);
E                 }
E               }

E               async function loadComprehensiveStats() {
E                 const el = document.getElementById('comprehensive-stats');
E                 if (!el) return;
E                 const hours = parseInt(document.getElementById('stats-report-hours')?.value || '24');
E                 el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text2);font-size:12px">⏳ Loading…</div>';
E                 try {
E                   const r = await api('GET', `/stats/comprehensive?hours=${hours}`);
E                   const t = r.torrents || {};
E                   const d = r.downloads || {};
E                   const f = r.files || {};
E                   const ev = r.events || {};
E                   const fmtBytes = b => b > 1e9 ? (b/1e9).toFixed(2)+' GB' : b > 1e6 ? (b/1e6).toFixed(1)+' MB' : (b/1024).toFixed(0)+' KB';
E                   const fmtDur = s => s > 3600 ? `${(s/3600).toFixed(1)}h` : s > 60 ? `${Math.floor(s/60)}m` : s+'s';
E                   el.innerHTML = `
E                     <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px">
E                       ${[
E                         ['Total Downloads', t.total||0, ''],
E                         ['Completed', t.completed||0, 'var(--green)'],
E                         ['Errors', t.errors||0, 'var(--red)'],
E                         ['Success Rate', t.success_rate_pct != null ? t.success_rate_pct+'%' : '—', 'var(--accent)'],
E                         ['Downloaded', fmtBytes(d.total_bytes||0), 'var(--blue)'],
E                         ['Avg Size', fmtBytes(d.avg_bytes||0), ''],
E                         ['Avg Duration', fmtDur(d.avg_duration_sec||0), ''],
E                         ['Total Files', f.total||0, ''],
E                         ['Blocked Files', f.blocked||0, 'var(--yellow)'],
E                         ['Total Retries', f.retry_total||0, ''],
E                         ['Error Events', ev.error||0, 'var(--red)'],
E                         ['Warn Events', ev.warn||0, 'var(--yellow)'],
E                       ].map(([k,v,c]) => `<div style="background:var(--surface2);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:6px">
E                         <div style="font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text2);font-weight:700">${k}</div>
E                         <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:${c||'var(--text)'}">${v}</div>
E                       </div>`).join('')}
E                     </div>
E                     ${r.daily_trend?.length ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:8px"><b>Daily completions (last ${Math.min(14, hours/24|0)} days):</b><br>${r.daily_trend.map(d=>`${esc(d.date)}: ${Number(d.cnt)||0}`).join(' · ')}</div>` : ''}
E                     ${Object.keys(t.sources||{}).length ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:6px"><b>Sources:</b> ${Object.entries(t.sources||{}).map(([k,v])=>`${esc(k)}: ${Number(v)||0}`).join(', ')}</div>` : ''}
E                   `;
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   el.innerHTML = `<span style="color:var(--red)">✗ ${esc(e.message)}</span>`;
E                 }
E               }

E                 window.open(`/api/stats/export?hours=${hours}`, '_blank');
E               }

E               async function triggerStatsSnapshot(button) {
E                 setButtonPending(
E                   button,
E                   true,
E                   'Taking…'
E                 );
E               
E                 try {
E                   await api(
E                     'POST',
E                     '/stats/snapshot'
E                   );
E               
E                   toast(
E                     'Stats snapshot taken',
E                     'success'
E                   );
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   toast(e.message, 'error');
E                 } finally {
E                   setButtonPending(button, false);
E                 }
E               }
E               
E               
E               
E               // ── Init ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
E               (async()=>{
E                 setDot('api',   'check', 'AllDebrid: checking…');
E                 setDot('aria2', 'check', 'aria2: checking…');
E                 setDot('db',    'check', 'DB: checking…');
E               
E                 // Load settings
E                 try {
E                   settingsData = await api('GET', '/settings');
E                 } catch(e) {
E                 }
E               
E                 renderTopbarActions();
E                 updateAria2ngLink();
E               
E                 // Load stats with visible retry
E                 let statsLoaded = false;
E                 let statsAttempt = 0;
E               
E                 while (!statsLoaded) {
E                   statsAttempt++;
E               
E                   statsLoaded = await loadStats();
E               
E                   if (!statsLoaded) {
E                     const delay =
E                       Math.min(
E                         400 + statsAttempt * 400,
E                         3000
E                       );
E               
E               
E                     await new Promise(
E                       r => setTimeout(r, delay)
E                     );
E               
E                     if (statsAttempt >= 10) {
E                       break;
E                     }
E                   }
E                 }
E               
E                 // Start background tasks immediately — do not wait for stats
E                 loadRecent().catch(() => {});
E                 checkConnections().catch(() => {});
E               
E                 // Generic statistics availability says nothing about provider health.
E                 // checkConnections() owns the provider-specific status surface.
E               
E                 // ── Server-Sent Events — live updates without 15 s polling ──────────────
E                 // Falls back to polling if SSE is unavailable (proxy, browser quirk, etc.)
E                 (function initSSE() {
E                   if (
E                     typeof EventSource === 'undefined'
E                   ) {
E                     return startPolling();
E                   }
E               
E                   var es;
E                   var sseOk = false;
E                   var fallbackTimer = null;
E               
E                   function connect() {
E                     try {
E                       es =
E                         new EventSource(
E                           '/api/events/stream'
E                         );
E               
E                       es.addEventListener(
E                         'connected',
E                         function() {
E                           sseOk = true;
E               
E                           if (fallbackTimer) {
E                             clearInterval(
E                               fallbackTimer
E                             );
E               
E                             fallbackTimer = null;
E                           }
E                         }
E                       );
E               
E                       es.addEventListener(
E                         'stats_changed',
E                         function() {
E                           loadStats().catch(()=>{});
E               
E                           if (
E                             document
E                               .getElementById(
E                                 'view-dashboard'
E                               )
E                               ?.classList.contains(
E                                 'active'
E                               )
E                           ) {
E                             loadRecent().catch(()=>{});
E                           }
E                         }
E                       );
E               
E                       var progressStatsTimer = null;
E               
E                       es.addEventListener(
E                         'torrent_updated',
E                         function(e) {
E                           let payload = {};
E               
E                           try {
E                             payload = JSON.parse(e.data || '{}');
E                           } catch (_) {}
E               
E                           const patchedExtraction =
E                             patchExtractionTransferEvent(payload);
E               
E                           const patchedProgress =
E                             patchedExtraction
E                               ? false
E                               : patchProgressOnlyTransferEvent(payload);
E               
E                           if (!patchedExtraction && !patchedProgress) {
E                             if (
E                               document
E                                 .getElementById('view-torrents')
E                                 ?.classList.contains('active')
E                             ) {
E                               loadTorrents().catch(()=>{});
E                             }
E               
E                             if (
E                               document
E                                 .getElementById('view-dashboard')
E                                 ?.classList.contains('active')
E                             ) {
E                               loadRecent().catch(()=>{});
E                             }
E               
E                             loadStats().catch(()=>{});
E                           } else if (!progressStatsTimer) {
E                             progressStatsTimer = setTimeout(
E                               ()=>{
E                                 progressStatsTimer = null;
E                                 loadStats().catch(()=>{});
E                                 if (patchedExtraction && payload.extraction_status !== 'extracting') {
E                                   if (document.getElementById('view-torrents')?.classList.contains('active')) {
E                                     loadTorrents().catch(()=>{});
E                                   }
E                                   if (document.getElementById('view-dashboard')?.classList.contains('active')) {
E                                     loadRecent().catch(()=>{});
E                                   }
E                                 }
E                               },
E                               1500
E                             );
E                           }
E                         }
E                       );
E               
E                       es.addEventListener(
E                         'ping',
E                         function() {}
E                       );
E               
E                       es.onerror = function() {
E                         if (!sseOk) {
E                           startPolling();
E                         }
E               
E                         es.close();
E               
E                         setTimeout(
E                           connect,
E                           10000
E                         );
E                       };
E                     } catch(err) {
E                       startPolling();
E                     }
E                   }
E               
E                   function startPolling() {
E                     if (fallbackTimer) return;
E               
E                     fallbackTimer =
E                       setInterval(()=>{
E                         loadStats().catch(()=>{});
E               
E                         if (
E                           document
E                             .getElementById(
E                               'view-dashboard'
E                             )
E                             ?.classList.contains(
E                               'active'
E                             )
E                         ) {
E                           loadRecent()
E                             .catch(()=>{});
E                         }
E               
E                         if (
E                           document
E                             .getElementById(
E                               'view-torrents'
E                             )
E                             ?.classList.contains(
E                               'active'
E                             )
E                         ) {
E                           loadTorrents()
E                             .catch(()=>{});
E                         }
E                       }, 15000);
E                   }
E               
E                   connect();
E               
E                   // Still refresh stats every 60 s as a safety net even with SSE
E                   setInterval(
E                     ()=>{
E                       loadStats().catch(()=>{});
E                     },
E                     60000
E                   );
E                 })();
E               
E                 setInterval(
E                   ()=>checkConnections().catch(()=>{}),
E                   60000
E                 );
E               })();
E               
E               
E               // ── Extraction Password List ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
E               // Internal state: real array, may contain empty strings during editing.
E               // Only filtered on save (saveSettings reads the hidden field which is kept in sync).
E               var _extractionPasswords = [];
E               
E               function _extractionPasswordsFromHidden() {
E                 var hidden = document.getElementById('s-extraction_password');
E                 if (!hidden || !hidden.value.trim()) return [];

E               async function setTorrentPriority(torrentId, priority) {

E                   await api('PATCH', '/torrents/' + torrentId + '/priority', {priority: parseInt(priority)||0}, 10000);
E                   loadTorrents();
E                 } catch(e) { toast(sanitizeErrorMsg(e.message), 'error'); }
E               }

E               
E               // ── Drag & Drop Priority Reordering ───────────────────────────────────────────
E               
E               var _dragSrcId = null;
E               
E               function onTorrentDragStart(e, torrentId) {
E                 _dragSrcId = torrentId;
E                 e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
E                 e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(torrentId));
E                 e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '0.5';
E               }
E               
E               function onTorrentDragEnd(e) {
E                 e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '';
E                 document.querySelectorAll('#t-tbody tr').forEach(function(r) {
E                   r.classList.remove('drag-over');
E                 });
E               }
E               
E               function onTorrentDragOver(e, torrentId) {
E                 e.preventDefault();
E                 e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
E                 document.querySelectorAll('#t-tbody tr').forEach(function(r) {
E                   r.classList.remove('drag-over');
E                 });
E                 e.currentTarget.classList.add('drag-over');
E               }
E               
E               async function onTorrentDrop(e, targetId) {
E                 e.preventDefault();
E                 e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');
E                 if (!_dragSrcId || _dragSrcId === targetId) return;
E                 // Move dragged item above the target: boost its priority by 1 relative to target
E                 try {
E                   // Get current rows to compute new priority
E                   var rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#t-tbody tr[data-torrent-id]'));
E                   var srcIdx  = rows.findIndex(function(r) { return parseInt(r.dataset.torrentId) === _dragSrcId; });
E                   var tgtIdx  = rows.findIndex(function(r) { return parseInt(r.dataset.torrentId) === targetId; });
E                   var newPriority = tgtIdx < srcIdx ? 10 : -10;
E                   await api('PATCH', '/torrents/' + _dragSrcId + '/priority', {priority: newPriority}, 10000);
E                   loadTorrents();
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   toast(sanitizeErrorMsg(e.message), 'error');
E                 }
E                 _dragSrcId = null;
E               }
E               
E               // ── Auto-Recovery ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
E               
E               async function runRecovery() {

E                   var res = await api('POST', '/recovery/run', {}, 30000);
E                   var r = res.result || {};
E                   toast(
E                     'Recovery done — ' +
E                     r.orphaned_queued_files + ' orphaned, ' +
E                     r.missed_completions + ' completions fixed, ' +
E                     (r.deadlock_reset ? 'deadlock reset' : 'no deadlock'),
E                     'success'
E                   );
E                 } catch(e) { toast(sanitizeErrorMsg(e.message), 'error'); }
E               }

E               async function loadAria2SpeedLimit() {
E                 try {
E                   var data = await api('GET', '/aria2/global-options', null, 10000);
E                   var externalControl = !!data.global_options_read_only;
E                   var bps   = parseInt(data.max_download_speed || 0);

E                               || (settingsData && settingsData.aria2_max_active_downloads)
E                               || 3;

E                   // ── Sync settingsData so PUT /settings uses the live value ───────────

E                     settingsData.max_concurrent_downloads   = maxDl;
E                     if (!externalControl) {
E                       settingsData.aria2_max_download_limit = bps;
E                     }
E                   }
E                   // ── Sync Settings-page inputs (Downloads → Settings, bidirectional) ──
E                   var inMad = document.getElementById('s-aria2_max_active_downloads');
E                   if (inMad) inMad.value = maxDl;
E               
E                   // ── Sync speed preset in Downloads panel ─────────────────────────────
E                   var sel = document.getElementById('aria2-speed-preset');
E                   var st  = document.getElementById('aria2-speed-status');
E                   if (sel) {
E                     var found = false;
E                     for (var i = 0; i < sel.options.length; i++) {
E                       if (sel.options[i].value !== 'custom' && parseInt(sel.options[i].value || 0) === bps) {
E                         sel.value = sel.options[i].value;
E                         found = true; break;
E                       }
E                     }
E                     if (!found) {
E                       sel.value = 'custom';
E                       var ci = document.getElementById('aria2-speed-custom');
E                       var cb = document.getElementById('aria2-speed-apply');
E                       if (ci) { ci.style.display = ''; ci.value = Math.round(bps / 1024); }
E                       if (cb)   cb.style.display = '';
E                     }
E                     if (st) st.textContent = '(' + fmtSpeedCap(bps) + ')';
E                   }
E               
E                   // ── Sync Max DL preset in Downloads panel ─────────────────────────────
E                   var msel = document.getElementById('aria2-maxdl-preset');
E                   if (msel) {
E                     var mfound = false;
E                     for (var j = 0; j < msel.options.length; j++) {
E                       if (parseInt(msel.options[j].value) === maxDl) {
E                         msel.value = msel.options[j].value;
E                         mfound = true; break;
E                       }
E                     }
E                     if (!mfound) msel.value = '3';
E                   }
E               
E                   // ── Update topbar badge ───────────────────────────────────────────────
E                   updateAria2TopbarBadge({
E                     limitBps: bps,
E                     maxDl: maxDl,
E                     externalControl: externalControl,
E                   });
E               
E                 } catch (e) { /* aria2 not connected — silently ignore */ }
E               }

E               async function _setAria2Speed(bps) {
E                 var st = document.getElementById('aria2-speed-status');
E               
E                 if (settingsData && (settingsData.aria2_mode || 'builtin') !== 'builtin') {
E                   if (st) {
E                     st.style.color = 'var(--text2)';

E                   updateAria2TopbarBadge({externalControl: true});

E                   await api('POST', '/aria2/global-options', {max_download_speed: bps});
E                   // Keep settingsData in sync so subsequent PUT /settings calls don't
E                   // overwrite this value with the stale cached number.
E                   if (settingsData) settingsData.aria2_max_download_limit = bps;
E                   if (st) { st.style.color='var(--green)'; st.textContent = bps > 0 ? 'Set: ' + fmtSpeedCap(bps) : 'Unlimited'; }
E                   setTimeout(function(){ if(st) st.style.color='var(--text2)'; }, 3000);
E                   updateAria2TopbarBadge({limitBps: bps});
E                   return true;
E                 } catch(e) {
E                   if (st) { st.style.color='var(--red)'; st.textContent='Error: '+e.message; }
E                   toast('Speed limit error: '+e.message, 'error');
E                   return false;
E                 }
E               }

E               function updateAria2TopbarBadge(patch) {
